title: Production team shows to-do list
goal: Make a to-do list that can be added, switched to completion status and deleted.
summary: form is responsible for reading new items, and the row template provides the text and buttons for each item. The list's click listener handles completion and deletion through the to-do row closest to the button, and applies to existing rows and new rows.
tasks: listens to the submit of #todo-form in script.js, prevents default submission and cleans up the blanks at both ends of the input. Empty content retains the original list.
Clone a row from #task-template, fill in the title with textContent, and append to #task-list. Clear the input box after successful addition.
listens for clicks on #task-list. Determine the operation through the data-action of the button, and then find the .task-row where the button is located. Click Delete to remove only this row.
Toggles this row's is-done class when clicked and updates the button's aria-pressed to true or false. The Done button can be clicked again to resume the to-do.
Add a strikethrough to the .task-title of the .is-done line in style.css to make it easier to identify things that can be continued from the list.

example.note: The reading list uses a listener to handle the remove button. The li the button is in determines which book to remove.

hint: If the operation always falls on the first row, check whether the .task-row is searched from the entire list. The closest row should be found starting from the button just clicked upwards. The completion status should also be written back to the row's button.
